doc.title: Neon Phantom Library
doc.logline: Navigate a haunted library maze as a glowing character, collecting spectral orbs while avoiding strategic ghostly librarians using clever routes and power-ups.

zones.name: White Vault
zones.description: The misty entry hall filled with glowing bookshelves and flickering neon lights.

zones.name: Spooky Yard
zones.description: An eerie courtyard surrounded by shadowed statues and glowing spectral runes.

zones.name: Avoiding Spire
zones.description: Narrow corridors twisted around an ancient tower where ghostly librarians patrol.

zones.name: Spooky Wilds
zones.description: A tangled section of the maze with neon-lit overgrowth and creeping shadows.

zones.name: Haunted Archive
zones.description: The final chamber filled with ancient tomes guarded by the strongest phantom spirits.

plot.premise: In the Neon Phantom Library, a glowing adventurer navigates a sprawling haunted maze filled with spectral orbs to collect. Ghostly librarians patrol intensely, requiring careful and strategic movement. Use temporary power-ups to outwit these spirits in a neon-lit pixel art world that's spooky yet playful and steadily paced.

characters.name: Lumo
characters.bio: A friendly neon spirit who offers advice and encouragement as you explore the haunted library.

beats.title: Welcome to the Neon Phantom Library

do.text: Welcome, brave soul. Collect the spectral orbs and evade the ghostly librarians. Use your wits and power-ups wisely.
You've reached the Spooky Yard. Stay alert; the librarians are close.
The librarians become cunning here. Use your power-ups to turn the tables.
You've collected many orbs. Grab power-ups to push forward!
This is the final challenge. Stay focused and collect the last orbs.
All spectral orbs gathered. Prepare for your escape!

endings.title: Victory
endings.text: You have successfully navigated the Neon Phantom Library, collecting all spectral orbs and outwitting the ghostly librarians. The library's mysteries brighten with your triumph.
